From 8cd2942e354687b6f655ef831d5d525d63dd46a8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Varun Thacker <varun@apache.org>
Date: Thu, 3 Aug 2017 09:50:00 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] SOLR-11182: A split shard failure on IOException should be
 logged


diff --git a/solr/CHANGES.txt b/solr/CHANGES.txt
index be89d0632ee..012ac868224 100644
--- a/solr/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/solr/CHANGES.txt
@@ -420,6 +420,8 @@ Bug Fixes
 * SOLR-11163: Fix contrib/ltr Normalizer persistence after solr core reload or restart.
   (Yuki Yano via Christine Poerschke)
 
+* SOLR-11182: A split shard failure on IOException should be logged (Varun Thacker)
+
 Optimizations
 ----------------------
 

diff --git a/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/update/DirectUpdateHandler2.java b/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/update/DirectUpdateHandler2.java
index 3efb748fd02..bfed1c17d9a 100644
--- a/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/update/DirectUpdateHandler2.java
+++ b/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/update/DirectUpdateHandler2.java
@@ -911,6 +911,7 @@ public class DirectUpdateHandler2 extends UpdateHandler implements SolrCoreState
     } catch (IOException e) {
       numErrors.increment();
       numErrorsCumulative.mark();
+      throw e;
     }
   }
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications Summary

#### Modifications in Each File

1. **`solr/CHANGES.txt`**
   - Added an entry under the "Bug Fixes" section to document the change related to logging a split shard failure on IOException. The entry states: "* SOLR-11182: A split shard failure on IOException should be logged (Varun Thacker)".

2. **`solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/update/DirectUpdateHandler2.java`**
   - In the `DirectUpdateHandler2` class, modified the catch block for `IOException`. Added a line to rethrow the exception after incrementing error counters, ensuring that the IOException is properly propagated.

#### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change in `DirectUpdateHandler2.java` addresses the issue noted in the `CHANGES.txt` file, which indicates that the handling of a split shard failure due to an IOException should be logged. By rethrowing the IOException, the update handler ensures that it can be caught and logged elsewhere in the system, fulfilling the requirement of the bug fix described in SOLR-11182.
